authoring: Each problem specification separately written; helper performs schema construction only, not parameter sampling. Stable existing IDs reused, contents replaced.
adaptationPrinciples: Exact reference identifies a type/method/wording model, never asserts that the new question was an official examination question.
Surd and exponent items include domains, missing-zero branches, coefficient constraints, conjugates, comparison proofs and applied geometry.
Quadratics include reconstruction, restricted intervals, parameter exceptions, variable-line contact, positivity proofs and model feasibility.
Equations and inequalities balance simultaneous systems, fractions, quartic-in-square substitution, regions, integer constraints and modelling.
Graphs include cubic simple/double roots, reciprocal and reciprocal-square branches, square-root endpoints, feature mappings, source-to-image point constraints and parameter intersection counts.
No calculus used in chapters1–4; maxima/minima proved by completing squares. No logarithm solving, root-coefficient theorem, inverse-function machinery or factor/remainder theorem used.
Rational inequality P1C03R08 matches actual P1Oct2021Q03(i); signs established directly, not relying on P3 methods.
